== Notes ==
* This effect is applied after using an [[Everlasting Mobstopper]].
* This is used to prevent multiple captures from one [[corpse]] by a single player, since the corpse disappears before this skill ends.
* [[Duration]] is 60 seconds.
* This effect does not disappear after you die, it maintains its full duration regardless.

[[de:Geschwächt von Dhuum]]
